title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-30
lineage: PCM -> Peak -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures a high‑energy 1982 show with a smoking Touch → Throwing Stones → Franklin’s Tower sequence.
ai_review.review: The set is praised as an all‑around powerhouse, especially the second half where Touch rolls into a rare Throwing Stones segue and erupts into Franklin's Tower. Listeners rave about the immersive audience‑board mix that feels like standing right beside the stage, delivering crystal‑clear sound throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews award 5 stars and highlight both superb performance and outstanding matrix recording quality, giving a near‑perfect combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as an "incredible audience board‑helped PCM" that feels close to the stage; clear, immersive sound with no reported flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set highlighted as especially strong; seamless transitions, notably the rare Touch→Throwing Stones→Franklin’s sequence, keep momentum high throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Described as "thundering" and superb, driving the band's energy.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent praised for brilliant, effect‑less keyboard work characteristic of early‑80s style.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill’s brief interaction noted; overall drumming supports the high‑energy performance.
